summary: r001 BRD-052: cau noi mat cat MIDAS PSC-1CELL/2CELL. bridge_evolution/midas_section.py giu dung ten + thu tu truong cua manual MIDAS API (vSIZE_PSC_A/B/C/D + JOINT, support article 35851688190105); dung da giac theo quy uoc hinh guide PSC Viewer (tutorial 05 FCM General Fig.4/5: phu ngoai BO1-1/BO1-2 do tu mut canh, phu trong BI*-n do tu tim, JO3 do tu goc day ngoai, HI4-1/HI4-2 do tu mat trong ban day len; H = HO1+HO2+HO3 = HI1+HI2+HI3+HI4+HI5); dac trung A/Iyy/Izz/tam/S/chu vi bang tich phan Green, kiem cong thuc dong hop chu nhat va doi chieu tutorial (Z3 = 0.51 m, t2 = t3 = 0.90 m trung so MIDAS hien thi; Z1 lab 2.10 vs MIDAS Auto 2.125 -> t1 chi uoc luong); xuat bang o dialog (kem o xam), Table Input TSV, JSON db/SECT (REFERENCE_ONLY), MCT *SECTION PSC 1CEL/2CEL (SYNTAX_UNVERIFIED, chua nap thu Civil 2022), DBUSER Box shape B (VERIFIED theo midas-mcp evidence); ho mat cat bien thien parabol/tuyen tinh cho duc hang (dinh giua nhip, don dieu, cap i/j Tapered); de xuat tu nhip/be rong bang bang heuristic LAB-HEURISTIC-UNSOURCED-* trong basis (claim IDEA); gene Super-T tu Studio -> PSC-Value da giac (dien tich khop section.py 1e-6). UI: tab 'Hop PSC kieu MIDAS' trong ban 'Sang tao mat cat' (gop voi Studio Super-T v2 nay co o nhap so bat luoi grammar + MAP-Elites) - doi so lieu la hinh PSC Viewer/dac trung/xuat doi theo tuc thi; API /api/midas/presets|psc-section|psc-family|propose|supert-value la lop goi mong trong scripts/serve_lab.py. Kiem tren trinh duyet: preset tutorial, ho 9 tram 7.0->2.7 m, de xuat 75 m x 12 m, PSC-Value tu Studio, console sach. Test: tests/test_midas_section.py 22/22 PASS; tests/test_lab_api.py + test_midas_section.py 32/32 PASS; full suite: exit 0, tat ca pass/skip (dem theo output: 1080 pass, 0 skip, 0 fail).
assumptions: Quy uoc huong do kich thuoc phu suy tu hinh guide PSC Viewer trong tutorial chinh hang (05 FCM General Fig.4/5), da doi chieu so trong tutorial; 2CELL (BI4 = nua day suon giua, hai lo doi xung) la gia dinh chua doi chieu guide 2CELL
Dinh dang dong MCT *SECTION cho PSC suy doan theo thu tu truong manual API; chi Table Input/dialog la duong nhap chac chan; DBUSER Box la duong du phong da kiem chung
Vi tri kiem cat Z1/Z2/Z3 va t1..t3 la uoc luong cua lab tai goc lo/tam; MIDAS Auto co the chon cao do khac (Z1 2.125 vs 2.10)
